description: Provision a Google Cloud Servicedirectory ServiceDirectoryEndpoint via Config Connector. Fields mirror the servicedirectory.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ServiceDirectoryEndpoint spec.

addressRef.description: Optional. The ComputeAddress resource whose IP address this endpoint uses. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeAddress resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/addresses/{{addressID}}" or "projects/{{projectID}}/regions/{{region}}/addresses/{{addressID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeAddress resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeAddress resource.

networkRef.description: Optional. The ComputeNetwork resource representing the GCE network of this endpoint. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeNetwork resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/networks/{{networkID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeNetwork resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeNetwork resource.

port.description: Optional. Port that the endpoint is running on, must be in the range of [0, 65535]. If unspecified, the default is 0.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The endpointId of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

serviceRef.description: Required. The ServiceDirectoryService that this endpoint belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ServiceDirectoryService resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/namespaces/{{namespaceID}}/services/{{serviceID}}".

name.description: The name of a ServiceDirectoryService resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ServiceDirectoryService resource.

title: GCP Servicedirectory ServiceDirectoryEndpoint
